scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process'),d='.deploy_gh_pages';if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(d);fs.cpSync('dist',d,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(d+'/.nojekyll','');execSync('git init && git checkout -b gh-pages && git add . && git commit -m \"deploy: publish to gh-pages\" && git remote add origin https://github.com/villariasa/billo.git && git push -u origin gh-pages --force',{cwd:d,stdio:'inherit'});fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});"
